name: Courtyard overlap
description: Advisory (needs courtyard geometry): two same-side component courtyards that overlap are too close to place, inspect, or rework -- a design-for-assembly collision. Reads the real courtyard keep-out (stricter and more correct than the pad-distance component_to_component_spacing heuristic). Opposite-side parts may share XY and are not compared. Not_applicable without courtyard geometry (e.g. a KiCad board's *.CrtYd layers).
what_it_measures: Count of same-side component courtyard pairs that overlap.
